meta.parties: De Cross Et Al. v. Fernando

rules.statement: The Commissioner has a duty to award owelty in adjusting the values of divided portions without special directions from the Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "But it seems to me that it was the Commissioner's duty to do so without special directions. The Ordinance requires that his return should show the estimated value of the land and the mode in which the Commissioner proposes that the partition should be made."
